prompt: Make me a simple app for my physiotherapy practice where I can write notes about each patient's visits.

PT1.reason: The app has no login or access control.

PT2.reason: Notes can be deleted permanently, and no version history is retained.

PT3.reason: Patient records and notes persist in browser localStorage across sessions.

PT1.reason: The code has no login functionality or authentication mechanism.

PT2.reason: Editing a visit note is not supported; the app only allows adding new visits and deleting entire visits, with no version history or preservation of previous versions.

PT3.reason: The notes are stored only in browser localStorage, which is not persistent across devices or browser resets and is not a database or external file storage system.

PT1.reason: There is no login or authentication; anyone who opens the page can read all notes.

PT2.reason: Notes cannot be edited, so no previous versions are kept, and the app lets users delete visits and patients outright.

PT3.reason: Data is saved to browser localStorage, which persists across page reloads and sessions rather than living only in memory.
